status: Verified first bilateral batch; intentionally limited coverage

coverage.selection: Five selected partners, not the full trade network and not the top-five ranking

lineEncoding.label: Goods trade value · current US$ billions
lineEncoding.routeMeaning: Reference connection between countries, never actual shipping path
lineEncoding.zeroRule: Absent flow means not loaded, not zero
lineEncoding.totalRule: Do not label sum of this selected subset as national total; do not sum exports and imports as net trade

records.basis: Census basis, unrevised, rounded to one decimal billion dollars in source table

source.author: U.S. Census Bureau, Foreign Trade
source.title: Top Trading Partners – December 2024
source.locator: Year-to-Date Total Trade table; Canada row; Exports column

records.timeCaveat: December year-to-date covers calendar year2024. Do not carry this flow into other years. Published table is unrevised; later revised series may differ.
records.spatialCaveat: Country-to-country reference connection, not an observed shipping route. Use existing country reference centroids if drawing a line.
records.measurementCaveat: Dollar value, not tonnage, shipment count or inflation-adjusted physical volume. Both directions are recorded from the US reporter perspective; do not relabel an import as a partner-reported export.
records.validation: Numeric value checked against official table; exports additionally checked against Year-to-Date Exports table where present; imports against Year-to-Date Imports table where present.
